text: MOUNT SLICE PREREQUISITES, measured not guessed. The composition root is server/index.ts and the pattern to copy is server/research/account-identity/production-mount.ts (105 lines) plus routes.ts, mounted by a single line registerProductionAccountIdentityApi(app) at server/index.ts:283. FOUR things the mount slice must satisfy. (1) An Express adapter is needed: mount.ts expects an AssistedOrderRegistry with a register(method, path, handler) method, and createAssistedOrderRouteTable in http.ts yields nine descriptors including an OPTIONS one, using Express-style :param paths. (2) A production-mount must resolve five dependencies through createAssistedOrderProductionComposition, which fails closed and returns a refusal reason rather than a service when any is null: catalog (CallbackAssistedOrderCatalogAdapter, to be pointed at master-offerings plus the Product Control price authority), repository (SupabaseAssistedOrderRepository over a SupabaseRpcClient), documents (SupabaseAssistedOrderDocumentStore over a private SupabaseStorageClient), outbox and audit. (3) EIGHT test files read server/index.ts and will judge the new call site: api-not-found, care/integration-wiring, core-site-protection, release-control-plane, research/access-architecture, account-identity/pack02-boundaries, research/catalog-display/routes, research/commerce/acceptance. pack02-boundaries asserts its own mount line appears EXACTLY ONCE, so the convention is one call site per feature and a second registration of anything is a guard failure. (4) verify-route-uniqueness checks for DUPLICATE identities rather than an exact total, so adding routes is allowed there; it currently reads 375 registrations across 366 call sites and that number will move. Client side, six pages under client/src/research/assisted-order are unrouted and the Early Access CTA does not exist. Do NOT half-wire the composition root: a partially wired root is how dev-only code reaches production.
